notes: A spec'd Subway Surfers endless runner: auto-run forward, run ends on collision, so Infinite Runner and its genre-wide P6, which the prompt independently demands with its speed-scaled minimum clear gap and its rule that no obstacle set may block all three lanes. lane-snap is stated outright — three 8-stud lanes at X = -8, 0, +8 with a lerped snap between them — so Lane Runner keeps its own shape and all three of its options, and I added obstacle-jump for the low barriers, hazard-kill for the collision that ends the run, powerup-buffs for the five listed pickups, and trigger-despawn for the volume that destroys chunks more than 200 studs behind. I deliberately did not add P2: the runnable train roofs sit where the train already blocks the ground lane and nobody walks on the tunnel shell, so no two walkable surfaces share a footprint, and the parallel per-player tracks offset 200 studs on X are duplicate instances of one track rather than separate maps, so no P4 either. Without a user I took the answer's bright cartoon subway theming as the skin for the five named chunk types and left the score, multiplier and powerup timers to HUD rather than adding marker-distance geometry the spec never describes.
